description:
About Our Brand and Products:

Aaron Leather Goods is a handmade leather goods brand offering high-quality, functional leather products designed for everyday use, travel, work, and gifting. Our collection includes leather duffle bags, travel bags, backpacks, briefcases, knife rolls, aprons, toiletry bags, wallets, organizers, and more.

What Makes Us Different:

We focus on genuine leather, skilled craftsmanship, practical designs, and quality construction. Our products are made to be durable, functional, and visually distinctive. We also offer customization options, allowing customers to personalize selected products for themselves or as gifts.

How Affiliates Can Earn:

Affiliates earn 10% commission on every qualifying order made through their unique affiliate link or referral. There is no minimum order value required to earn commission. Commissions are paid within 30 days according to the affiliate program's payout terms.

How to Promote Us:

Affiliates can promote Aaron Leather Goods through:
• Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Pinterest
• YouTube videos and Shorts
• Blogs and product reviews
• Email newsletters
• Gift guides and lifestyle content
• Travel, fashion, cooking, and professional content
• Product recommendations, unboxing videos, and social media posts

Use your unique affiliate link when sharing our products so your referrals can be properly tracked.

Other Information:

Aaron Leather Goods offers a wide range of handmade leather products suitable for travelers, professionals, chefs, gift buyers, and anyone who appreciates quality leather goods. Affiliates are encouraged to create authentic, engaging content and share products that genuinely fit their audience.

Affiliate Commission: 10% on every qualifying order
Payout: Within 30 days
Minimum Order Value: None
